strategy.name: Aggressive (Quality) Momentum — Paper
strategy.desc: Concentrated swing & momentum trades in liquid large/mid-cap stocks and broad sector ETFs. Rides relative strength with 18% trailing stops; cuts losers fast. Quality floor: price ≥$10, real revenue, liquid. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no margin. Aggressive = concentration + conviction in good names.
rules: Enter on 2+ triggers: breakout, momentum leadership, oversold snapback, or dated catalyst.
Size by risk: shares = (10% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 40% of equity per name.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16–24): trim effective risk ~25%, be more selective.
18% trailing stop on every position — switch at entry, never remove.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−10%) hit; stand down for month at −30% MTD.
Quality only: ≥$10 price, liquid US large/mid-cap, no leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no memes.
